program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rot90 cells)
      (let ((h (+ 1 (apply max (map first cells)))))
        (normalize-cells (map (lambda (p) (list (second p) (- h 1 (first p)))) cells))))
    (define (rotate cells k)
      (let loop ([i 0] [cur (normalize-cells cells)])
        (if (= i (modulo k 4)) cur (loop (+ i 1) (rot90 cur)))))
    (define ctrl (first (find-color g 1)))
    (define code (cond [(and (= (first ctrl) 0) (= (second ctrl) 0)) 0]
                       [(and (= (first ctrl) 0) (= (second ctrl) (- (cols g) 1))) 1]
                       [(and (= (first ctrl) (- (rows g) 1)) (= (second ctrl) (- (cols g) 1))) 2]
                       [else 3]))
    (define a (normalize-cells (obj-cells (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0))))))
    (define b (rotate (obj-cells (first (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 3)) (objects g 0)))) code))
    (define xor (append (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p b))) a)
                        (filter (lambda (p) (not (member? p a))) b)))
    (if (empty? xor)
        (empty-grid 1 1 0)
        (let* ((norm (normalize-cells xor))
               (h (+ 1 (apply max (map first norm))))
               (w (+ 1 (apply max (map second norm)))))
          (grid-from-fn h w
            (lambda (r c) (if (member? (list r c) norm) 8 0)))))))
